test_command: cmake --build build --config Debug --target test_exe > $null; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit 1 }; Set-Location build/bin/Debug; ./test_exe.exe --gtest_filter=DoorLockingTest.*

mutations.catches: a lock that reports success and turns nothing
a stretch of floor accepting a lock, which leaves a doorState on a tile that is no door
a second lock on the same door reporting that it did the locking
every door in the dungeon placed locked
